Definition: Amalek, a descendant of Esau; also his posterity and their country
BiblicalUsage: Amalek = "dweller in a valley"; 1) son of Eliphaz by his concubine Timnah, grandson of Esau, and progenitor of a tribe of people in southern Canaan; 2) descendants of Amalek
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
